title: TweetStream sniper example config
description: Strategy config shared by the TypeScript and Rust bots. Every property has a default; a minimal config only needs rules.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion.

rules.description: The rules. Each has one mode.

maxSignalAgeMs.description: Ignore posts older than this at receipt (publish time from the post id).
maxSignalAgeMs.$comment: Safety: a replayed or delayed post must not trigger a buy at a stale price.

safety.description: On-chain and third-party checks run in parallel before a buy.

budgetMs.description: Time limit for all checks together, in milliseconds.
budgetMs.$comment: Latency: the most a check can add before the send. A check that misses it counts as unknown.

onUnknown.description: What a check that failed or timed out means.

rugcheck.description: off: skip. advisory: reject only on a danger result that arrives in time. required: no answer counts as unknown.
rugcheck.$comment: Latency: an extra HTTPS request in the parallel check set.

maxRugcheckScore.description: Reject when the normalised risk score is above this. null turns the score test off.

rejectMintAuthority.description: Reject tokens whose supply can still be increased.
rejectMintAuthority.$comment: Skipped for pump.fun curve tokens, whose authorities are fixed by the program.

rejectFreezeAuthority.description: Reject tokens whose holder accounts can be frozen.

rejectRiskyExtensions.description: Reject Token-2022 mints with transfer hooks, permanent delegates, default-frozen accounts, pausing, or non-transferable tokens.

spend.description: Hard caps on SOL spent, kept in state/live.json (or state/dry-run.json) across restarts. Each buy reserves its largest possible cost: amount, fees, tips, and account rent.

maxPerHourSol.description: Most SOL spent in any rolling hour.

maxTotalSol.description: Most SOL this bot will ever spend.

takeProfitPct.description: Sell when the position is up this many percent. null turns it off.

stopLossPct.description: Sell when the position is down this many percent. null turns it off.

maxHoldSec.description: Sell after this many seconds. null turns it off.

pollMs.description: How often to price open positions.
pollMs.$comment: Each poll is one RPC read per pump.fun position, one quote per other position.

sellOnDelete.description: Sell when the post that triggered the buy is deleted.

sellSlippagePct.description: Slippage for exit sells, in percent.

execution.description: How transactions are built and sent.

computeUnitLimit.description: Compute unit limit for locally built pump.fun trades.
computeUnitLimit.$comment: A tight limit makes the priority fee per unit higher for the same SOL.

blockhashRefreshMs.description: How often the background loop fetches a fresh blockhash.
blockhashRefreshMs.$comment: Latency: keeps the blockhash fetch off the hot path.

rebroadcastMs.description: How often an unconfirmed transaction is sent again.

confirmTimeoutMs.description: Give up waiting for confirmation after this long and mark the outcome unknown.

accountSpec.description: Numeric X account id (digits only) or @handle.

scanDepth.description: 0 reads only the account's own text. 1 also reads the post it quotes, replies to, or reposts. 2 goes one level deeper.

name.description: Unique name, used in logs and in the state file.

enabled.description: Turn the rule on or off.

mode.description: What makes the rule fire. See docs/modes.md.

accounts.description: Accounts to watch: numeric X account id or @handle.
accounts.$comment: Ids survive handle changes; handles do not. Prefer ids.

sources.description: ca_scanner: where an address may come from.
sources.$comment: meta and ocr arrive in a later tweet/meta event, so they fire later than text.

minConfidence.description: ca_scanner: lowest signal confidence to act on.

requireMintInBio.description: ca_scanner: also require the address in the account's last known bio.
requireMintInBio.$comment: Safety: a hijacked account rarely edits its bio first.

reactor.description: engagement: the account whose retweet, quote, or reply fires the rule.

targetTweetId.description: engagement: id of the post the reactor must engage with. Empty means match by reactedTo.

reactedTo.description: engagement: accounts whose posts count as targets when targetTweetId is empty.

actions.description: engagement: which kinds of engagement count. Likes are private on X, so they cannot be watched.

includeKeywords.description: engagement, new_tweet, fomo: fire only when one of these words appears within scanDepth (fomo reads the thesis text).

excludeKeywords.description: engagement, new_tweet, fomo: never fire when one of these words appears within scanDepth.

events.description: new_tweet: which actions fire the rule. bio fires on a bio change.

followEvents.description: follow: fire on follows, unfollows, or both.

targets.description: follow: only fire when the followed account is one of these. Empty matches any.

fields.description: pfp_update: which profile fields fire the rule.

callers.description: callout: pump.fun usernames whose callouts fire the rule. They must also be tracked in the dashboard's Callouts tab.

calloutKinds.description: callout: which callout kinds fire the rule. author_update, reply and repost are later posts about an earlier call.

maxMultiple.description: callout: skip when the event reports the token already ran more than this multiple since the call. null turns it off.
maxMultiple.$comment: Safety: buying after a 5x run buys someone else's exit.

requireCallerPosition.description: callout: fire only when the event reports that the caller holds the token (position.amountHeld above 0).

fomoUsers.description: fomo: FOMO usernames or author ids whose theses fire the rule. Track them in the dashboard's FOMO tab too.

fomoCoins.description: fomo: coin addresses. A thesis by any author on one of these fires the rule, and so does the coin's first observed verification.

fomoEvents.description: fomo: fire on theses, on first observed token verification of a watched coin, or both.

useDetectedCa.description: engagement, new_tweet, follow, pfp_update: trade the first contract address found in the event (post text, token link, image text, the followed account's bio, or the new bio) when token.mint is empty.

mint.description: The token to trade. ca_scanner, callout and fomo: leave empty to trade the address in the event, or set it to act only on that token. Other modes: required unless useDetectedCa is true.

amountSol.description: SOL to spend on the buy.

filters.description: Checks run after a rule fires and before anything is sent.

maxSnipes.description: How many tokens this rule may buy, counted from the buys in the state file. 0 means no limit.
maxSnipes.$comment: Safety: caps losses from a rule that fires on a compromised account.

cooldownSec.description: Seconds to wait after this rule fires before it may fire again.
cooldownSec.$comment: Safety: stops a burst of posts from buying many tokens.

minTokenAgeSec.description: Skip tokens younger than this. null turns the check off.

maxTokenAgeSec.description: Skip tokens older than this. null turns the check off.

minMarketCapUsd.description: Skip tokens with a smaller market cap. null turns the check off.
minMarketCapUsd.$comment: pump.fun curve tokens are priced from the curve read; other venues need market data.

maxMarketCapUsd.description: Skip tokens with a larger market cap. null turns the check off.

minLiquidityUsd.description: Skip tokens with less liquidity. null turns the check off.

maxPoolTaxPct.description: Skip tokens whose transfer fee is above this percent. null turns the check off.
maxPoolTaxPct.$comment: Read from the mint account, so it costs no extra request.

platforms.description: Venues this rule may trade on, such as pumpfun, pumpswap, raydium, meteora, orca, moonshot. Empty allows any.
platforms.$comment: pumpfun is built locally; every other venue goes through Jupiter.

skipSuspiciousPools.description: Skip tokens that the safety check service flags as dangerous.

onMissingData.description: What to do when a filter needs data that is not available in time.
onMissingData.$comment: reject is the safe choice: unknown never counts as passing.

slippagePct.description: Largest price move you accept, in percent.
slippagePct.$comment: Too low and fast-moving launches fail; too high and you overpay.

priorityFeeSol.description: Priority fee for the whole transaction in SOL, or auto for a recent-fee estimate.
priorityFeeSol.$comment: auto reads a cached estimate refreshed in the background, so it adds no latency. The whole fee counts against the spend caps.

tipSol.description: Tip paid to the Jito block engine in SOL, or auto for the recent landed-tip level.
tipSol.$comment: Only paid when antiMev is on.

antiMev.description: Send only through the Jito block engine, with a tip, which protects the transaction from sandwiching. Off: send to the RPC URLs instead.
antiMev.$comment: Jupiter trades are landed by Jupiter and ignore this.
